title: Reports: Monthly report must allow selecting month and year

requirements.text: Update the Reports page "Report Configuration" so that when "Report Type" is set to "Monthly", the user can explicitly choose the report month and year (instead of relying on an arbitrary day-based date picker) before running/printing the report.

quotes:
on Report tab, Report Configuration
Report Type: Monthly - It does not let me select what month and year I want to print. it has to ask me. or I need to be able to select the month that I want to run the report

acceptanceCriteria: When Report Type = "Monthly", the UI shows a clear Month selector and Year selector (English labels).
Changing Month/Year updates the computed startDate/endDate used for filtering revenue/expenses/COGS totals to the selected calendar month.
The page’s "Financial Summary - … to …" header reflects the selected month’s date range.
The "Print Report" action prints the report for the currently selected month/year without requiring the user to manually pick a specific day.

requirements.text: Preserve existing behavior for other report types (Daily, 3 Months, 6 Months, Annual) while ensuring the date/month/year inputs remain understandable and consistent with the selected report type.

quotes: Report Type: Monthly - It does not let me select what month and year I want to print.

acceptanceCriteria: Daily reports still allow selecting an exact date.
3 Months / 6 Months still compute ranges relative to the user-selected reference date (or an equivalent clearly labeled reference control).
Annual reports still allow selecting a year (either via the existing date input or a dedicated year selector), and the computed range remains Jan 1 through Dec 31 of that year.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not modify frontend immutable hook/entry files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts).
nonGoals: No backend/canister changes are required for this request.
No changes to report calculations beyond using the user-selected month/year to derive the existing start/end date range.
No new export formats (PDF/CSV) or emailing/sharing features.
